summary: Coupon box block for displaying discount promotions with apply or copy-code actions.
features: Multiple variants (with icon, with discount field)
Apply button or copy code button options
Customizable background, text, and icon colors
shortDescription: The Coupon Box Studio block promotes discount codes anywhere on the site. Two variants are available: one with an icon for visual emphasis, another with a discount input field for direct application. Action buttons support either applying the coupon automatically or copying the code to clipboard for checkout. Full color customization ensures the promotion stands out while matching brand guidelines. Place on homepage banners, product pages, or cart sidebars.
